_note: Canonical pi-cli models.json for cloud dispatch, reviewed against Pi 1.5.2. Committed to the repo so cloud dispatches succeed from environments without a workstation-configured ~/.pi/agent/models.json. metaproc.cloud.gcp.batch_backend.build_pi_models_json reads this as a fallback and rewrites the project ID in baseUrl at dispatch time. A models[] entry whose id matches a Pi built-in model replaces it wholesale (zero cost, default limits, no thinking map), so this file lists only models Pi does not ship and states deliberate differences from built-in models as modelOverrides. Built-in IDs Metaproc accepts are listed in metaproc.config.model_catalog.
_source: The vertex-maas catalog is maintained from public Vertex AI model metadata. The google-vertex provider uses Pi's native `google-vertex` API so Gemini thought-signature round trips are preserved; see the adapter compatibility runbook. Copied capability and price fields follow Pi 1.5.2's built-in catalog for the sibling model or the provider's published model page.

vertex-maas._note: Vertex AI MaaS preview minimums vary by model. GLM-5, GLM-4.7, Kimi K2 Thinking, DeepSeek V3.2 and both Qwen3 models retired 2026-10-21. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is available through at least 2026-12-31. Costs use Vertex Standard PayGo rates.
vertex-maas.apiKey: !sh -c 'if [ -n "$METAPROC_PI_API_KEY" ]; then printf "%s" "$METAPROC_PI_API_KEY"; else exec gcp-access-token.sh; fi'

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Vertex AI MaaS, preview)
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (Vertex AI MaaS, preview)

google-vertex._note: Pi 1.5.2 ships Gemini 3 Flash and Pro variants and Gemini 4 Argon as built-in google-vertex models. Active Vertex projects retain access to 3.6 Flash until 2027-01-28. This catalog adds Gemini 4 Carbon, Hydrogen and Neon. Pi maps Gemini 4 thinking levels through high. Carbon's price is Google's launch rate, which rises to $4/$20/$0.20 per million tokens on 2026-12-01.

openai._note: Pi 1.5.2 ships the GPT-6, GPT-6.1, GPT-5.6 and gpt-5.5 models as built-in Responses API models, so their prices, thinking maps and compat flags come from Pi. The overrides keep the published context windows (1,050,000 tokens for the GPT-6 and GPT-5.6 families, 1,000,000 for gpt-5.5) where Pi records the 272,000-token standard-price tier. GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol were released 2026-11-17, after Pi 1.5.2, and are defined here on the Responses API with the GPT-6.1 Sol capability flags. The API key comes from OPENAI_API_KEY through Pi's built-in lookup.

anthropic._note: Pi 1.5.1 turned Anthropic message threads on by default for api.anthropic.com, so a request sends only new messages and the server continues the stored conversation. This keeps the full-request behavior of the Pi releases Metaproc used before. All Anthropic models are Pi built-ins; the key comes from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or auth.json.

moonshot._note: Metaproc's moonshot provider uses the capabilities and thinking levels from Pi 1.5.2's moonshotai provider and Moonshot's published 5-minute K3 cache-write rates. kimi-k3.1-pro and kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed use separate API IDs. kimi-k2.6 has been closed to accounts registered after 2026-11-01, and Moonshot expects to retire it in late December 2026. The API key comes from MOONSHOT_API_KEY.
